engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a small e-commerce storefront selling everyday goods (totes, bottles, lamps, notebooks) with user accounts, order management, an admin user panel, and a contact form.

demo_journeys.name: Browse and add a product to cart
steps: Land on the shop listing and see the six products
Click into Canvas Tote (product/1) to see its detail page
Click 'Add to cart' on the product page
Navigate to /cart and confirm the item appears in the cart

demo_journeys.name: Log in as a returning customer
steps: Open /login
Enter email and password, click 'Log in'
Verify you land on the shop as 'Hi, Bob Tester'

demo_journeys.name: Register a new account
steps: Open /register
Fill in Name, Email, and Password (8+ chars)
Click 'Create account' and confirm you are signed in on the shop

demo_journeys.name: Review and manage orders
steps: Navigate to /orders
See the existing order #1000 with 1 item, $45.00
Click 'Delete' to remove the order (demonstrate data management)

demo_journeys.name: Explore the admin user panel
steps: Navigate to /admin
Review the user table (Bob, Alice Admin, Carol, Dave, Erin)
Demonstrate role visibility (admin vs user)

demo_journeys.name: Update account settings
steps: Navigate to /account
Edit the Display name field
Click 'Save' and confirm the change persists

verdict.why: 5 critical failure(s) on the demo path or on high-risk features.

report.summary: Our e-commerce site is not safe to demo before the client, with five critical failures covering broken resource loading on the homepage, a missing Help link, a broken Continue shopping link on the cart, a layout issue between desktop and phone, and an account display name that fails to update and persist. Beyond those critical items there are five other failures, one issue needing human review, four blocked checks, and 142 items not yet tested, set against 410 passed across 13 pages.
